name: Contextual AI
tagline: Enterprise RAG platform for building grounded, specialized AI agents over technical knowledge.
description: Contextual AI is an enterprise platform for building retrieval-augmented AI agents that answer over a company's technical documentation, specifications, and institutional knowledge. It exposes individually tunable RAG components — document parsing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation — plus an agentic search and research layer, so teams in regulated, high-accuracy domains (finance, engineering, legal) can automate complex knowledge work while keeping answers grounded in source material. Available as multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant SaaS, or private VPC, with developer APIs.
insight: Founded in 2023 by Douwe Kiela, who co-authored the original RAG paper while leading research at Meta.
edge: Built around specialized, individually-tunable RAG components — parse, rerank, and generate — for grounded accuracy in high-stakes technical domains.
pros: Private VPC and single-tenant deployment options
cons: Pricing is enterprise sales-led, not transparent
Aimed at technical/regulated industries, not consumers
Requires data and knowledge-base setup to shine

references.title: San Francisco's Contextual AI raises $80m to scale platform
